question: Should the repository replace its sole pinned release-signing SSH key with the proposed signer before the v0.14.3 release process is merged?
rationale: The diff intentionally changes the release trust anchor; source review cannot establish key ownership, continuity, or authorization without an independent maintainer/security decision.

options.title: Approve after independent key verification
options.body: Verify the new fingerprint and signer authorization out of band, then merge only after inspectable redacted runtime proof is attached.

options.title: Hold the key rotation
options.body: Keep the existing pinned signer and defer this release-path change until the key transition can be independently verified.

recommendation.title: Approve after independent key verification
recommendation.body: Verify the new fingerprint and signer authorization out of band, then merge only after inspectable redacted runtime proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed trust entry and current release-path commits are tied to this signing identity, although approval should be independently performed.
